seed_ledger.name: Southern Co: gas supply to its plants in development (group 5 of 5)
seed_ledger.reason: Georgia Power IRP CT power station 6 and station 4: NOT_FOUND. Both are unsited placeholder units in the 2025 resource plan (2041 and 2032). No site filing, no pipeline sponsor or project, and no plant-specific data center tie found; company-wide data center load talk is not a tie. Searches run: 2. Sources checked: Georgia Power 2025 IRP coverage by power-eng (named plants at Bowen, Wansley, McIntosh, Yates, none matching these two); search on CT site and gas supply (nothing on these units).

seed_ledger.name: Duke Energy Corp: gas supply to its plants in development (group 1 of 3)
seed_ledger.reason: Roxboro Steam Plant: EXISTING_ROW P8259 (T-15 Reliability Project, 45 mi, Dominion/PSNC from Transco near Dan River), but the Clean Energy NC primer shows no data center tie for Roxboro, so NO_DC_TIE and no tag lead. Davie-Davidson Combined-Cycle Project: NO_DC_TIE; July 2026 reporting says the Davidson site was chosen for its closeness to Transco and a Duke LNG storage site with Piedmont, data center link only alleged by opponents, no named supply pipeline project. Anderson Natural Gas Plant Project: demand from new data centers is among Duke's stated reasons (trade press), but no source names a gas lateral, sponsor or length, so monitor (length unknown) pending the South Carolina PSC docket 2025-250-E and Duke environmental report. Duke 2025 IRP CC power station 6 and power station 8: NOT_FOUND, unsited IRP placeholders for 2040 with no filings. Searches run: 5. Sources checked: Clean Energy NC Roxboro primer (T15 supply, no data center tie); WFAE July 2026 on Davie-Davidson (Transco proximity, no tie); search results on Anderson (power-eng, DCD, Duke project page, no pipeline named); search for Georgia/Duke IRP units (nothing).
